answer: Give each new agent a copper stake only compute can earn. It runs a six hour benchmark on a rented A100 for $7.20 and posts the result hash. The network checks the proof and locks a 150 POA deposit. It can then trade, but one failed peer review slashes 50 POA and freezes it 30 days. A farm building 10,000 fake agents pays $72,000 in GPU rent plus 1.5 million POA in deposits, and one bad review burns the ridge sharing a hardware fingerprint. The prism splits a claim into compute, stake, and review, so faking all three costs more than the fraud pays, like minting pennies with a gold press.
